turns.question: For customers whose first order was placed in October 2026, what was the median number of days between their signup date and that first order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it offers no median, nor any days-from-signup-to-first-order figure. The closest metrics are signup_to_first_order_rate (the share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up, by signup month) and signups.
